why.trigger: EP-0008 showed that the headline conclusion of EP-0003 was conditioned on mean concurrent running jobs. EP-0002's 21-cell phase diagram changed theta at fixed offered load, which mechanically changes E[need], arrival rate, and therefore running-job concurrency.
why.stake: The phase diagram is a headline result in the domain Research Home. It cannot remain interpreted as a theta or heterogeneity effect until the old cells are placed on the newly discovered concurrency axis and the sufficiency of that axis is challenged with controlled distributions.

E11_phase_remeasurement.design: rerun the srpt and sf_srpt half of E2 exactly: N=64, theta in {0.4,0.6,0.8,1.0,1.25,1.6,2.0}, rho in {0.7,0.85,0.95}, 30000 jobs, seeds 201..205; add mean_running to the retained metrics
E11_phase_remeasurement.acceptance: mean_jct, utilization, rho_emp, min_flow_balance, and flow_balance_by_need must reproduce results/E2.json with maximum absolute difference <= 1e-12 before the new concurrency measurement is accepted
E11_phase_remeasurement.measured: mean_running, mean_jct, utilization, flow_balance by need, and class-starvation markers

E11_equal_summary_controls.design: at N=64 and rho=0.85, construct two groups with E[need] exactly 4 or 16. Within a group, all three shapes use the same p(need=64), hence the same maximum-job ratio, E[need], offered load, arrival rate, expected running-job concurrency, and service distribution. Only the background need distribution changes.

shapes: geometric support {1,2,4,8,16,32} fitted to the background mean
geometric support {1,2,4,8,16,32} fitted to the background mean

detector.class_starved: mean flow_balance of need=64 across five seeds < 0.5
detector.class_healthy: mean flow_balance of need=64 across five seeds >= 0.5
detector.same_classification: all three shapes in one equal-summary group are either class_starved or all class_healthy
detector.invariant_flow: max mean flow_balance(need=64) - min mean flow_balance(need=64) <= 0.15

predictions.claim: the exact E2 rerun reproduces the old metrics before mean_running is accepted
predictions.criterion: maximum absolute difference over the five acceptance metrics and all 210 rerun rows <= 1e-12
predictions.falsified_if: the deterministic replay differs; stop and diagnose rather than interpret concurrency

predictions.claim: theta was strongly confounded with running-job concurrency in the old phase diagram
predictions.criterion: under sf_srpt, mean_running decreases strictly with theta at each rho and the theta=0.4 value divided by the theta=2.0 value is >= 10 at all three rhos
predictions.falsified_if: any rho is non-monotone or has an endpoint ratio below 10

predictions.claim: the old greedy-SRPT class-starvation cells occupy the high-concurrency side of the remeasured grid
predictions.criterion: the minimum mean_running among class-starved phase cells is greater than the maximum mean_running among non-class-starved phase cells
predictions.falsified_if: the two sets overlap on mean_running

predictions.claim: DECIDING. Maximum-job ratio plus running-job concurrency is sufficient for the need=64 starvation classification across background shapes
predictions.criterion: both equal-summary groups pass matched_concurrency, same_classification, and invariant_flow
predictions.falsified_if: either group changes starvation classification, has a flow-balance range above 0.15 despite matched concurrency, or fails the concurrency manipulation check

predictions.claim: with maximum-job ratio fixed at 1, the high-concurrency mean4 group starves need=64 under greedy SRPT, while the low-concurrency mean16 group does not
predictions.criterion: all mean4 shapes have mean flow_balance(64) < 0.5 and all mean16 shapes have mean flow_balance(64) >= 0.5
predictions.falsified_if: either group is not uniform or the direction is reversed

predictions.claim: the equal-summary construction actually matches observed running-job concurrency
predictions.criterion: both groups satisfy matched_concurrency under srpt
predictions.falsified_if: either group's relative range exceeds 10 percent

predictions.claim: EASY backfill remains class-healthy in every equal-summary control
predictions.criterion: mean flow_balance(64) >= 0.9 in all six controls

pre_committed_consequence.if_Y4_and_Y5_pass: reinterpret EP-0002's stability portion on the concurrency axis. Retain theta or heterogeneity only for residual policy-ranking differences that remain inside an equal-summary group; do not call theta the cause of starvation.
pre_committed_consequence.if_Y4_fails: weaken Current Understanding v8: maximum-job ratio and mean running-job count are not a sufficient state description. Promote background-shape or packing fragmentation to a third candidate variable and do not publish a two-number rule.
pre_committed_consequence.if_Y5_fails: the E9 concurrency curve does not transport across need-distribution families. Restrict it to the family in which it was measured and design a new factorial experiment.
pre_committed_consequence.if_Y1_fails: do not grade Y2 or Y3. Diagnose replay drift first. The controlled arm may be recorded but cannot be used to rewrite EP-0002.

declared_unknowns: mean_running is a time-average output and partly a consequence of flow balance; matching its expectation does not prove identical queue-state geometry
the equal-summary controls vary higher moments and packing structure together; a failure identifies insufficiency but not which descriptor is causal
E11 uses the synthetic MSJ model and does not add real-cluster evidence
aggregate mean-JCT policy ranking in the controls is exploratory; no directional prediction is sealed for it
rules: The prediction file and grading code are committed before results/E11.json exists.
The sha256 is stored in predictions/PRED-010.sha256 before the runs.
Failed predictions remain in the ledger as failed.
